meta_description: Advanced Gardening is Nottingham's trusted landscape gardening specialist. Design, build, and maintain beautiful outdoor spaces. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Landscape Design & Build — Nottingham & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Bespoke landscape design and professional build work that turns tired outdoor spaces into stunning gardens you'll love to spend time in.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Nottinghamshire
services_subhead: From initial design through to finished installation and ongoing maintenance, we handle every aspect of your garden project.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke landscape designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create detailed plans and 3D visualisations so you can see the finished result before work begins.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of quality patios, decking, and hardscaping. We work with natural stone, composite materials, and timber to create durable outdoor living spaces.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection and professional border creation to add colour, texture, and structure. We choose species that thrive in your garden's conditions.

services.title: Fencing & Garden Structures
services.desc: Strong, attractive fencing, pergolas, arbours, and raised beds. Built to last with quality materials and expert craftsmanship that complements your garden design.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including hedge trimming, lawn care, weeding, and seasonal work. Keep your garden looking pristine throughout the year with our reliable maintenance plans.

services.title: Clearance & Landscaping
services.desc: Complete garden overhauls including site clearance, levelling, and reshaping. Perfect for unlocking the potential of overgrown or neglected outdoor spaces.

about_pullquote: I build gardens that families actually use and enjoy every single day.
about_para_1: Advanced Gardening was founded in 2012 by a lifelong gardening enthusiast frustrated with generic, uninspired outdoor spaces. Over twelve years, we've transformed over 400 gardens across Nottinghamshire—from small courtyards to sprawling country properties. Every project starts with a genuine conversation about your vision, your space, and what will make you happiest.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on listening carefully, delivering on time, and standing behind our work. Most of our business comes from repeat clients and referrals because homeowners know we'll treat their garden with the same care we'd give our own. We combine creative design with practical horticultural knowledge, so your new garden isn't just beautiful—it's sustainable and easy to maintain.
reviews_heading: What Nottinghamshire Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our overgrown back garden cleared and completely redesigned. The team was professional, tidy, and kept us updated throughout. The finished garden is exactly what we wanted—our kids love it and we're out there every evening. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Fantastic service from start to finish. They listened to what we wanted, came back with brilliant ideas we hadn't thought of, and built it perfectly. Not the cheapest quote but absolutely worth every penny. The quality of the work is outstanding.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using Advanced Gardening for maintenance for three years now. They're reliable, punctual, and genuinely care about keeping the garden looking good. My neighbours have already asked for their number. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Susan H.
